title: Aramaic Documents from Ancient Bactria (Khalili Collection) / Арамейские документы из Бактрии
author: Achaemenid satrapal chancery of Bactria
edition: Naveh & Shaked, Aramaic Documents from Ancient Bactria (2012); copyrighted.
ru_evidence: CyberLeninka 'Бактрия арамейские документы Халили': 0 hits; no Russian translation found.
en_evidence: Naveh & Shaked 2012 edition with English translation (en.wikipedia 'Khalili Collection of Aramaic Documents').
value: Bactrian administration on the eve of and under Alexander: Bessus as king, and a text dated 'year 7 of Alexander'. A unique documentary counterpart to Arrian and Curtius.
ai_feasibility: high: Imperial Aramaic is well within LLM competence and the corpus is small. Copyright of the edition means permission is needed to republish the source.
pilot_unit: The 18 leather letters + the Alexander-dated document
